outcome_decision.split: Outcomes A-E and the minimal specific rank are decided ONLY on VALIDATION at the primary ranks {1,4}. TRAIN-K4 is in-sample and DESCRIPTIVE. TRAIN fail + VAL pass => reported as VAL PASS with the TRAIN fail flagged. TRAIN pass + VAL fail => FAIL.
outcome_decision.specific_at_r: primary verdict PASS at rank r on VALIDATION (Holm over {1,4}, recovery CI-lo>0, all gates; INCOMPLETE/VOID/CANNOT ANSWER are not PASS).

mapping.A: basket specific at r1 AND button not at r1 but at r4
mapping.C: neither specific at r1, both at r4
mapping.D: basket specific at some r in {1,4}, button at neither
mapping.E: neither codeword specific at either rank
mapping.CANNOT_ANSWER: any VOID / INCOMPLETE FAMILY / CANNOT ANSWER cell needed for the mapping
mapping.other: any other pattern is reported literally (e.g. button-only specificity)

outcome_decision.descriptive_ranks: {2,8,16,32,50} inform curve shape only; they stay UNSUBMITTED unless GPU allows after P4/S-084

cross_job_overlap_rule.rule: Any cell whose arms come from more than one host is analysable only if, for EVERY host pair present, an OVERLAP_OK file covers it: arms already completed in the earlier job (KO, KO_CAND_r1, KO_RAND_r1_0, KO_DER_r1_0) are re-run on the later host under distinct OVL tags (hcsi_p2b_<cw>_k4ovl_*, never read by the analyzer) and must match per row with identical prompt_id sets and max |dy_install| <= 1e-6, both on NVIDIA RTX A5000 (p2b_overlap_check.py). Otherwise the cell is VOID (shared). Same-host different jobs are treated as one host. Any arm not on RTX A5000 => VOID. Add-on arms have their own overlap gate (add-on VOID only) and their jobs re-run KO in-allocation.
